About

Designer. Geologist. Structure-minded.

I’m Winning Stephen Kanu, the designer behind Carl Art and Design. I build logos, identity systems and social content for founders in tech and clean energy, and for health, agro and food brands too.

I trained as a geologist before I became a designer. Reading rock layers taught me that anything that looks solid is built from layers laid down with intent. I design brands the same way: mark, palette, type, content, each layer reinforcing the one beneath.

Alongside client work I’ve kept up a pencil-and-pastel practice since 2019. It keeps my hand honest and still shapes how I judge composition and weight on screen.

I work in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, and I take on freelance and full-time roles with clients anywhere in the world.
